body.description: Compilation and rendering preserve authority ceilings and never create permission.
Deterministic target-neutral projection plus trace ledger and unsupported residue.
A closed target-neutral compilation plan was produced.
Compilation stopped with explicit unsupported or invalid semantic residue.
Validate and lower one governed model into a target-neutral compilation plan.
Lifecycle of one compilation attempt.
One closed, owner-qualified AlchLang carrier-v2 model.
Identifiers never determine types, actors, permissions, effects, or tests.
Every term, fact, state, event, rule, action, permission, owner, and authority reference resolves.
All required carrier sections and typed semantic expressions are closed.
Compile and atomically write deterministic local generated artifacts.
Caller-injected bounded adapter implementing one local action effect.
Evaluate rules, permissions and authority before invoking one explicitly selected local adapter.
An action runs only when its exact authority boundary is present in caller-supplied grants.
Parse explicit textual syntax into one carrier-v2 candidate without semantic name inference.
UTF-8 Markdown carrying one explicit AlchLang code block.
Generation is available only when meta-type, integration binding, generator and executable conformance are closed.
Compile exact admitted meta-type, binding, generator and conformance registries into candidate pattern entries.
A worker owns a message only through an expiring lease; another worker may reclaim it after expiry.
An action-declared effect with explicit pattern, binding, writes, emitted events, guarantee and failure continuation.
Explicit allowlisted HTTP transport configuration.
Consumer-side SQLite store of atomically applied message identities.
Return the current candidate inventory filtered by derived availability without changing state.
Inspect and explicitly dispatch pending local Outbox messages to a selected local stdout transport.
Registry of operation patterns and their explicit generation prerequisites.
Bounded operational observation emitted by commit, replay, claim, publish, retry, dead-letter or requeue.
Stable architecture-pattern status requires a separate explicit owner decision and cannot be derived from registration or passing tests.
Lifecycle separates registration, local availability and owner-controlled stability.
A candidate operation pattern and its current prerequisite states were registered.
Upgrade the local provider schema from the earlier pending/published table to versioned lease and dead-letter state without losing rows.
Register one candidate pattern with explicit meta-type, integration binding, generator and conformance prerequisites.
Digest-bound record of registry inputs, resolved prerequisites, generated output and deterministic replay.
Delivery failures schedule exponential retry up to a declared attempt ceiling, then enter dead letter until explicit requeue.
Resolve an action to a local provider only when its performs edge, effect, pattern, binding, guarantee, failure continuation and authority boundary match exactly.
Commit explicit business state and pending Outbox messages atomically in one local SQLite transaction.
Apply one local consumer mutation and its inbox receipt atomically, returning duplicate for an already processed message.
Local SQLite persistence boundary containing versioned aggregate state and pending or published Outbox messages.
Provider-specific operation that atomically commits business state and pending Outbox messages in local SQLite.
One bounded sfol-v1 term and formula kernel supplies every declarative Rule, Query filter, Permission condition, transition guard, Action condition, Policy case, and Calculation term.
Evaluate one closed typed backend contract against caller-supplied immutable input.

SFOL owns truth conditions; Action and Effect own intended behavior; Integration Bindings form infrastructure responsibilities; registered runtime providers execute; ORODI evaluates bound operational evidence. Binding, execution, observation, verdict, owner acceptance, and deployment remain distinct.
Evaluate checked UInt64 arithmetic with explicit division rounding.
A typed contract produced its deterministic value without implicit effect.
Caller-supplied immutable typed fields or rows.
Construct an explicit target shape from typed source fields or defaults.
Typed evaluation cannot access providers, mutate state, emit events, execute selected targets, or acquire authority.
Deterministic value produced only from the closed contract and caller input.
Select the first matching declared target or explicit default without execution.
Filter, order, limit, and project caller-supplied rows without fetching or mutation.
A selected target identifier that remains unexecuted and unauthorized.
